headline: Lightspeed Narrows Quarterly Net Loss as Revenue Edges Higher
summary: Lightspeed Commerce posted a quarterly net loss of $4.2 million, narrowing significantly from a loss of $32.7 million a year earlier, as revenue saw modest growth.
why: Point-of-sale software providers' path to profitability and top-line growth trends are closely watched by tech-sector growth investors.

impacts.name: Lightspeed Commerce
impacts.why: A sharply narrowed quarterly net loss and growing revenue indicate improved operational efficiency.
